{{Top|leg}}
A '''drug patch''' was a small, triangular patch that could be used to knock someone out. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Caranna]] used a drug patch to incapacitate the bounty hunter [[Tendin Vought]], whom she suspected of planning to betray her.
